notes.title: Demo now available!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn3.kongcdn.com/assets/files/0002/0996/worm_update.gif[/img]

Hey everyone, we've been thrilled with how much people have been enjoying the game, but we wanted to give even more players the opportunity to check it out! We've just put a playable demo of the arcade mode up on Steam. If you've been wanting to give the game a try, or know a friend who might enjoy it, there's no better time than now to give it a shot!

This demo is what we've brought to show off the game at many conventions, including PAX East 2017. It shows off the early sections of the arcade mode, and ends with the boss fight against the Cyberworm. We're excited for everyone new to the game to try it out! Download it now by clicking the Download Demo button on the game page.

notes.title: GRIDD: Retroenhanced 1.1 Update Live
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28046272/75b40fc5ad5b6e6c74903690d580f68d5df9082a.gif[/img]

The first week of the game being live on Steam has been a blast! Thanks to everyone for leaving such glowing reviews and making great videos of the game :D

We've got a few minor updates and fixes for the game this week.

[list]
    [*]Optimization and overall stability improvements
    [*]Minor bugs fixed
    [*]UI improvements
    [*]Improved desktop icon quality
[/list] 

If you're enjoying the game, please let us know by leaving a review! If there are any specific issues that you're seeing, let us know by [url=https://help.steampowered.com/en/wizard/HelpWithGame/?appid=553950]going to the game's Steam Support page[/url]
